name: browser
description: Control the user's Chrome: open tabs, read pages, click, type, press keys and scroll, through the Ollamapaca Chrome extension.

tools.name: create_tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a new Chrome tab (or switch to a tab already showing it) and return the page: title, numbered interactive elements, and text.

url.description: Full URL or domain, for example https://news.ycombinator.com or github.com

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load a URL in the current tab and return the page.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the current page: title, URL, numbered interactive elements like [12] button "Sign in", and visible text. Call this before click or type to get element refs.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by its ref number from read_page, then return the updated page.

ref.description: Element number from read_page, the N in [N]

text.description: Visible text of the element, only if you have no ref

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into an input or text area. Pass the ref number from read_page; without a ref it types into the focused field or the page's search box. Replaces existing text. Set submit to true to press Enter afterwards, for example to run a search.

ref.description: Element number of the input from read_page

clear.description: Clear existing text first, default true

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press one key in the current tab: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Space, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, PageUp, PageDown, Home or End.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the current page and return what is now visible.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back to the previous page in the current tab.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Get the full visible text of the current page, for reading long articles.

tab_id.description: Tab id from list_tabs. Optional: defaults to the tab you used last, or the active tab.

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open Chrome tabs with their ids, titles and URLs.

tools.name: switch_tab
tools.description: Make a tab active by its id from list_tabs and return its page.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab by its id from list_tabs.

tools.name: webmcp.list_tools
tools.description: List WebMCP tools that open pages registered for sites the user allowed. Most sites have none.

tools.name: webmcp.execute_tool
tools.description: Run a WebMCP tool returned by webmcp.list_tools, with its exact site origin.

allowlist.sites: user's own Chrome, through the extension
